author: Temmycreative
title: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid)
content:
Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid)

Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s–90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt.

Requirements:
* One skeleton as the main character
* Punk/rock retro horror vibe
* Clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS)
* Large back print (13” × 16”)
* Neon green, purple & orange palette
* Original artwork only (no tracing existing designs)

Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price. Contact: reply on the Threads post https://www.threads.com/@temmycreative_/post/DdzVJUhiFl1

author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content:
Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both.

Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me.

See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each.

Follow-up: For character art, gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration. Book is lighter fantasy but wants grounded, lifelike art. Open to different styles. Bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for now; may expand if the art style fits the series.

For the map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel; stylistically open.

Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites. https://www.threads.com/@veliraiyawrites/post/Ddz7KZNCetH
